scope: New pending destination-creation cancellation and thrown-rejection recovery tests in the real ScrapeView-to-SaveSourceForm orchestration.
covered_paths: With Project creation deferred, Save, Close, and place-type controls are disabled; Save cannot land early. A cancelable native dialog cancel event is prevented while pending, the dialog and Source draft remain, and cancellation works after creation resolves.

A thrown Project creation rejection displays an error, clears pending state, preserves the project-name draft, and does not land early. Retrying stages the returned Project and lands with its association; proceeding without a destination lands with an empty association list.
limitation: The test asserts the Close control is disabled but does not separately invoke a direct cancellation callback while creation is pending, bypassing that control.
product_or_browser_claim: None. This is a source-test review only; no tests were run and no browser, native, persisted-product, or full defect-closure claim is made.
state: EXT-D-0187 remains in-fix; T04/T29 remain partial.
